coverage.notes: DKU teaches its main undergraduate degree in English and first-years apply to the university, not to particular majors. Its official current catalogue lists 14 majors, many with multiple tracks, across three main academic divisions; students declare majors in year two. This selective pack researches three institutional-strength examples (Data Science, Environmental Science, Global Health), not all majors. Undergraduate majors handoff: https://ugstudies.dukekunshan.edu.cn/academics/majors/ . Current 2026-27 Registrar bulletin exists; Class of 2031 degree rules and 2027-28 tuition should be checked when published. Chinese-citizenship entry is a distinct application route.

institution.summary: English-medium, four-year Sino-US liberal arts university in Kunshan; graduates earn both Duke University and DKU degrees.

programmes.credential: Dual bachelor's degrees: Duke University (United States) and Duke Kunshan University (China)

programmes.about: An interdisciplinary major combining statistics, computing and mathematical methods to analyse data across scientific and social problems.
programmes.overview: Study the mathematical and computational methods used to turn raw data into evidence for decisions. The major combines statistics, calculus, linear algebra, programming, machine learning and data visualisation. Students examine applications in science, health, economics and other disciplines while building technical and interdisciplinary skills. Electives include artificial intelligence and software systems, and the wider undergraduate curriculum provides opportunities for independent Signature Work.

programmes.name: Environmental Science with tracks in Biogeochemistry, Biology, Chemistry, and Public Policy
programmes.credential: Dual bachelor's degrees: Duke University (United States) and Duke Kunshan University (China)
programmes.campus: Duke Kunshan University, Kunshan, Jiangsu, China
programmes.language: English (with language-study requirements based on proficiency)
programmes.about: A combined natural- and social-science major examining environmental systems, human impacts, and possible scientific or policy responses.
programmes.overview: Explore how environmental systems interact with human societies, drawing on biology, chemistry, Earth systems and public policy. Students choose among biogeochemistry, biology, chemistry and public policy tracks while completing shared interdisciplinary environmental-science coursework. Topics include climate change, pollution, ecosystem processes and how environmental policy is developed and implemented. Coursework and experiential learning prepare students for further study or work in environmental research, management and related fields.

programmes.name: Global Health with Tracks in Biology and Public Policy
programmes.credential: Dual bachelor's degrees: Duke University (United States) and Duke Kunshan University (China)
programmes.campus: Duke Kunshan University, Kunshan, Jiangsu, China
programmes.language: English (with language-study requirements based on proficiency)
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary major investigating health inequalities and cross-border health challenges through biology, public health and policy.
programmes.overview: Study health problems that cross national borders through biology, social science and policy. The major covers determinants of health, health ethics and health systems, with one track emphasising biology, disease and laboratory science and the other emphasising economics, policy and governance. Students undertake interdisciplinary coursework and can pursue electives in areas such as epidemiology and environmental health. The curriculum supports further study and work in research, public policy and health-related organisations.

claims.statement: An interdisciplinary major combining statistics, computing and mathematical methods to analyse data across scientific and social problems. Electives include artificial intelligence and software systems, and the wider undergraduate curriculum provides opportunities for independent Signature Work.

claims.statement: A combined natural- and social-science major examining environmental systems, human impacts, and possible scientific or policy responses. Explore how environmental systems interact with human societies, drawing on biology, chemistry, Earth systems and public policy. Students choose among biogeochemistry, biology, chemistry and public policy tracks while completing shared interdisciplinary environmental-science coursework. Topics include climate change, pollution, ecosystem processes and how environmental policy is developed and implemented. Coursework and experiential learning prepare students for further study or work in environmental research, management and related fields.

claims.statement: An interdisciplinary major investigating health inequalities and cross-border health challenges through biology, public health and policy. Study health problems that cross national borders through biology, social science and policy. The major covers determinants of health, health ethics and health systems, with one track emphasising biology, disease and laboratory science and the other emphasising economics, policy and governance. Students undertake interdisciplinary coursework and can pursue electives in areas such as epidemiology and environmental health. The curriculum supports further study and work in research, public policy and health-related organisations.
